verdict.rationale: Morph is an API service, so a telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The pack documents no opt-out control. The only privacy-related item is a community quote of tiered training-data policy (free tier may train on code, enterprise does not), which is a plan difference about training use, not a user opt-out of telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
